macros.name: gmhypertarget
macros.doc: \gmhypertarget makes a \hypertarget and a \label of the given name.

macros.name: gmiflink
macros.doc: \gmiflink makes a \hyperlink to the given \hypertarget if the correspondent label exists, otherwise typesets an ordinary text.

macros.name: gmifref
macros.doc: \gmifref makes a (hyper-)\ref to the given label if the label exists, otherwise it typesets an ordinary text.
